title: The Rocky and Hoodwinkle Show
description: The adventures of Hoodwinkle, a none-too-bright moose, and his pal Rocky, a none-too-bright boxer.
quote: Hey Rocky! Have you beat that bag into powder yet?
altHero: Hoodwinkle, a moose scientist, doing an experiment
alt2: Hoodwinkle’s experiment has gone awry and he now has three eyes and a snake tongue
alt3: Rocky Balboa punching a punching bag
